§ 101.01  Designation; Citation; Headings
(a)   All ordinances of a permanent and general nature of the City of Cleveland as revised, codified, rearranged, renumbered and consolidated into component codes, titles, chapters and sections shall be known and designated as the Codified Ordinances of Cleveland, Ohio, 1976, for which designation “Codified Ordinances” may be substituted. Code, title, chapter and section headings do not constitute any part of the law as contained in the Codified Ordinances.
(RC 1.01)
(b)   All references to codes, titles, chapters and sections are to such components of the Codified Ordinances unless otherwise specified. Any component code may be referred to and cited by its name, such as the “Administrative Code”. Sections may be referred to and cited by the designation “Section” followed by the number, such as “Section
101.01”.
